description: This file contains utility functions for stripping prefixes and suffixes from strings, part of the Abseil C++ library.

methods.name: ConsumePrefix
methods.description: Removes the specified prefix from the string view if present, returns true if successful.

methods.name: ConsumeSuffix
methods.description: Removes the specified suffix from the string view if present, returns true if successful.

methods.name: StripPrefix
methods.description: Returns a string view with the prefix removed if it matches, otherwise returns the original string view.

methods.name: StripSuffix
methods.description: Returns a string view with the suffix removed if it matches, otherwise returns the original string view.
